item.title: 2 U.S. planes are down and Iran hits Gulf refineries as the war wraps its 5th week
item.summary: An F-15 went down in Iran and a second Air Force plane crashed near the Strait of Hormuz as the war capped a week of intensified fighting.

item.title: Trump's ballroom fight sheds new light on an underground White House bunker
item.summary: The status of a decades-old bunker beneath the now-demolished East Wing is unclear, but the Trump administration has cited security concerns in its legal filings in favor of continuing construction.

item.title: A U.S. jet goes down over Iran, a U.S. official confirms
item.summary: A U.S. official said that one crew member had been rescued and U.S. forces continue to search for the second crew member.

item.title: Trump budget seeks $1.5 trillion in defense spending alongside domestic program cuts
item.summary: In his annual budget, President Trump is asking Congress to boost defense spending to $1.5 trillion, the largest such request in decades.

item.title: How Big Thief refreshed its emotional palette on 'Double Infinity'
item.summary: The indie rock band's sixth studio album was Big Thief's first as a trio, following the departure of bassist and founding member Max Oleartchik.

item.title: The labor market springs back to life in March as employers add 178,000 jobs
item.summary: The U.S. job market perked up last month as employers added 178,000 jobs. The unemployment rate dipped to 4.3%, mainly because the number of people seeking work declined.

item.title: Verdicts against Meta and Google may bring a new era of big tech accountability
item.summary: Advocates hope recent verdicts against social media platforms will build momentum for bigger changes in Silicon Valley.

item.title: NASA's Artemis II crew are quite the photographers. See what they've snapped so far
item.summary: Many of the photos that have come out of the moon mission so far were taken by crew members. NASA says the crew is getting guidance from scientists on what to capture when they get closer to the moon.

item.title: Going up! 'Elevator Songs' is a high-concept, emotionally turbulent ride
item.summary: On a new album, the experimental vocal group Roomful of Teeth and songwriter Gabriel Kahane take up residence in a multidimensional hotel with a time-traveling elevator and a quirky clientele.

item.title: Dark wedding comedy 'The Drama' has a provocative premise — but it never commits
item.summary: Early on, Zendaya and Robert Pattinson's new movie The Drama takes a turn. We're talking about it here: spoilers ahead.
